text:
Maya R.: spotted possible secrets exposure in staging backup index: contains base64 iv/token fragments. file gs://staging-backups/index-2026-03-21.ndjson
Tom L.: can you paste a sample line?
Maya R.: `...meta:{iv:"AAECAwQFBgcICQoLDA0ODxAREhM="}, user_id: 42`
Isha (infra): base64 length looks like 16 bytes (AES iv). treat as sensitive. I'll suspend backup-agent push and list affected objects.
Tom L.: quick repo grep shows debug log printing IVs in staging build: `log.Debugf("iv=%s", b64(iv))` - DEBUG flag was set in helm values accidentally.
Maya R.: immediate actions: 1) remove affected backups, 2) rotate backup service account keys, 3) create new KMS wrap key and plan rewrap, 4) tighten bucket IAM to backup-ops only.
Isha (infra): doing RBAC change now and nuking recent objects (keeping audit entries). opened ticket INFSEC-431 for rotation work.
ScanBot: automated scan: 4 matching objects found across last 30 days.
Raj (legal): hold partner notifications until we confirm PII. Isha please share sample scan output DM.
Tom L.: patch ready to stop IV logging and bump helm to INFO; will coordinate deploy after RBAC change.
Maya R.: agreed, will own postmortem. closing loop after INFSEC-431 updates.
